title: Eco Green Solar CMS v2.5.3
summary: Fix Complaints CSV Report Export & High-Performance In-Browser Excel Customer Directory Sync (Fix 413)
features: 📊 Reliable Complaints CSV Export: Implemented authenticated /api/reports/export-csv endpoint with client-side fallback to ensure 1-click CSV download always succeeds.
🚀 In-Browser Excel Processing (Fix Status 413): Switched customer directory Excel parser to client-side SheetJS engine, completely eliminating Vercel 4.5MB payload limit errors.
⚡ Instant Analytics & Warranty Calculations: Automatically recalculates 0-5 year warranty statuses for 6,000+ customer records instantaneously in browser memory.
